convoLines.text: "Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
Something eases in their shoulders. "Good. We're better with you here. I mean that."
"Saw things with too many joints. Give them room. That's the whole lesson."
"...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.
"Still on whether you're staying."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"Look, forget it. You wanted something?"
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
They go very still. Not relaxed-still. Held-still.
"I don't actually want to belong somewhere. I want to be remembered. Someone I love needed the lie more than I needed the truth."
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Henry grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
Their eyes do the math before their mouth does. You can see the calculation happening.
"That again?" Henry sighs. "I confessed that already. I'm not confessing it twice for dramatic effect."
Henry looks at you, level. "I told you the truth. You can keep poking it, but it's told."
"You're a good listener, you know that?" A tired smile.
"Sure. I'll be around."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"See you around."
"What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"Shock's underrated. It's the body's way of buying you time."
"a spring that runs clear — trace it with your finger. That's where it is, and it's real."
"a burned farmhouse — walk it with me sometime and you'll know the ground. It's real."
"Still on what got you through the first week. ...if that helps."
"...Fine. This had better be worth it."
"Alright — I should get back to it."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"Take care out there."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"God, yes. That's the dream now. Eight hours of not being afraid. Hm."
"What?" They go still. "Say that again — slower."

They nod. "Okay."
"I don't know you well enough for that. Ask me again when we've survived something together."
"I should get back to it."
They glance at the fire, then back. The quiet doesn't seem to bother them.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"Take care out there."

"This one — Doum Palm. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
The easy manner evaporates. What's left is watching you back.
"Okay." Henry looks down. "Okay. It was me. 1× Plant fiber — I was hungry and I... I'm sorry." Their voice is small.

lines: d11: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Javier Ivanov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d11: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d11: 🕯️ Javier Ivanov is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d11: What Javier kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d11: "Javier's gone." Henry looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Javier." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d11: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Nolan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.

d11: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d11: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d11: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Javier Ivanov, 11 days. The mantle passes to Nolan Corpuz.
d11: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Nolan Corpuz, 39 — a taxi driver. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach.
d11: The village's quarrel was with Javier — and Javier is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d11: At the grave, Henry speaks for Nolan — "Javier trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d11: The fire knew Nolan before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d57: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d57: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d57: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.

d57: 📖 LEARNED: Draw Fire (Level 1). In the wilds, beside your people, you make yourself the problem. Shout, wave, bleed loudly — the beast's eye stays on you and off them. Monsters focus you instead of your allies.
